comparison.objective: Fit a terminal cover; candidate commissions an adjustable axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover alignment and fastening/snapping versus recessed-tool engagement, fine rotary setting, counterholding, torque control, and iterative cycle observation.
comparison.success_condition: Properly fitted terminal cover is implied; candidate requires two repeatable controlled impacts plus lock stability. Cover seating and damage criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Protective-cover fitting does not evaluate damping adjustment or physical response calibration.
